services.name: NCCP Clinics
services.desc: To be eligible to umpire at a provincial championship in Saskatchewan, an umpire must be a Certified Official, which means they must have completed BOTH the online learning and an in-person umpire camp. If you registered before March 1, you will need to go back and redo your registration. The system was not supposed to allow registration, so the umpire packages were not yet set up if you registered early and therefore you will not have submitted your payment for registration. Once you complete your registration, you will then need to go into the clinics and camps section and register for a level 1.1 (First year), level 1.2 (second year) or 2.2 online clinic AND an on-field clinic.
